rituals.title: TWO-SOURCE AGREEMENT
rituals.mission: Verify one fact twice outside your head.
rituals.rule: The two sources must be independent.
rituals.play: Choose one safe present detail—for example, current time or location. Check it on one external source, then confirm it with a second source or trusted person.
rituals.twist: If the sources disagree or you still feel unsafe, stop the game and seek human/professional support.
rituals.win: One reality anchor is supported by two independently checkable sources.
rituals.mind_bend: When two genuinely independent sources converge on the same present fact, agreement becomes a stronger safety check than repeated reporting from one information stream.
